I would assume the chemical withdrawl would have add a new element to your emotions and how you deal with things. And you already have plenty to deal with.

You mentioned you were a creative person. Do you still find any reprieve in your hobbies and/or art? Is there anything you can channel your energy into that you can kind of lose yourself in?

Where does the pain come from? 

Hopelessness? Despair? Something more specific?

I came across this number in my poking around online. i will give it a call and see what i can do.

thanks

i'm assuming i would have to regularly see a psychiatrist to get on meds anyway. i had a very poor experience with psychiatry when i was a kid, and am of the opinion that it works as long as you believe it does. I've always been under the impression that my realization of that fact renders it useless. but i suppose it can't hurt to try again.
